description: Look up a company on its official register: search by name to find candidates, or fetch a single company by its number to get the full public record. UK companies come from Companies House (registered name, number, status, incorporation date, registered office address, SIC codes, directors/officers, and filing deadlines). Irish companies come from the CRO (registered name, CRO number, status, company type, incorporation date, registered address and the annual return date); a CRO number is digits only. Use this during onboarding to find and confirm the user's company ("is this your company?"). Read-only: it does NOT save anything; use link_company to save the confirmed company. If the result says the lookup is not available, tell the user plainly and take their company details directly with update_company. French companies come from the Annuaire des Entreprises (registered name, SIREN, status, legal form, incorporation date, registered address, activity code and officers); search by name or by SIREN (9 digits). Other countries have no register lookup; ask the user for their company details directly.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

company_number.description: Exact company number to fetch the full record + directors + deadlines. Use once you know the number (e.g. after the user confirms a search candidate).

query.description: Company name to search for (returns up to ~10 candidates with number, status, and address). Use when you have a name but not a number.

name: lookup_company
title: Lookup Company
